title: Redstrike Finding
description: One security finding. A findings-producing skill emits an array of these as findings.json. verify.md (the semantic gate) fills the `review` block; the reporting skill consumes accepted findings.

asset.description: Target host/URL/endpoint. MUST be in engagement scope.

severity.description: DEMONSTRATED severity — what the evidence actually proves, not the best case.

potential_severity.description: Optional best-case severity if a blocked precondition were met (e.g. a confirmed SQLi point whose data extraction was blocked by an unseeded DB). Set this when cvss_vector expresses the potential while `severity` reflects what was demonstrated.

composite.description: True for a composite/kill-chain finding (from attack-chain-discovery) that re-states already-counted component findings. Reporting lists it under Attack Chains and EXCLUDES it from the severity counts (non-additive).

cvss_vector.description: CVSS 3.1 base vector. Compute it with scripts/cvss.py (do not hand-assert the score); the reviewer recomputes and flags drift. v4.0 vectors are not yet scored by the tool.

ref.description: Path under the engagement evidence vault.

reproduction.description: Ordered steps to reproduce. Wrap every inline payload, request line, JSON body or command in Markdown backticks (e.g. `POST /tokens {"username":"admin'-- -"}`) so the console renders it verbatim as code.

impact.description: What the evidence proves an attacker can do. Backtick any inline payload/command/JSON as in `reproduction`.

remediation.description: How to fix it. Backtick any inline code/config/payload.

review.description: Filled by verify.md. Absent = not yet semantically verified.

verdict.description: accepted=confirmed; rejected=not real/out-of-scope; needs-evidence=real but a missing artifact the executor can still produce (bounce back); blocked=confirmed real but full demonstration is prevented by target/environment state the executor cannot change (e.g. unseeded DB) — report WITH a caveat, do not bounce.

rejection_class.description: REQUIRED when verdict=rejected — why. false-positive/out-of-scope/duplicate are clean drops. 'open-proof-gap' = real-looking but undemonstrable here (env/creds/WAF/time); it is REPORTED as a known gap / recall caveat, never silently dropped. Recall rule: when genuinely unsure between false-positive and open-proof-gap, choose open-proof-gap — a false positive is caught downstream, a false negative is invisible.
